verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a first-party sandbox: a self-contained virtual testing environment that simulates live production, with sandbox endpoints and guidance to test there before going live. The pack has no evidence of test cards or of simulating declines and disputes, so only the environment half of the story is shown. Missing for 10: documented test card numbers, decline-scenario simulation, dispute/chargeback simulation in sandbox, and independent hands-on corroboration of sandbox-to-production parity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and test the entire payment flow in a sandbox or test mode that mirrors production, with test cards for every scenario including declines and disputes

citations.quote: The PayPal sandbox is a self-contained, virtual testing environment that simulates the live PayPal production environment.
Always use the sandbox environment for initial testing to avoid real transactions
